method.order: stdio/env/headers, reversed in middle trial; one-client controls and ten-client fleets
method.workload: fresh handshake, six-tool catalog, list_projects, list_notification_providers, eight resources, then two repeat projects/provider pairs per client
method.client: @modelcontextprotocol/client 2.0.0, synthetic codex0.163.0, modern protocol pinned2026-07-28 on all transports
method.stdio: SDK stdio subclass solely to probe in-place; exactly one process per client, no disposable negotiation sibling
method.http: stock StreamableHTTPClientTransport; ten independent SDK Client objects, one fresh loopback daemon per fleet; environment identity shared or token headers request-isolated
method.daemonReadiness: wait for application server-listening event, not just open TCP port; launch time included
method.cache: warm filesystem; preflight pilot warms OS/backend caches; no cold-disk/desktop/download claims
method.timeouts: 20 seconds per RPC, unchanged; report all failed attempts separately
method.sampling: sum owned server-process RSS sampled every500ms using ps, plus final post-workload RSS and process CPU time; observer overhead present and scales with process count; not peak/PSS or parent/backend CPU
method.cleanup: close clients then owned PID termination and confirmed absence; all processes stopped
method.statisticalUnit: three fleet trials per mode/concurrency cell; client operations are not independent repetitions
